name: Southern Dagaare
notes: Southern Dagaare, a Gur (Mabia) language of northwestern Ghana and Burkina Faso. STUB: the grapheme inventory is NOT yet specified. Written in a Latin orthography using African-reference-alphabet letters (ɛ, ɔ, ŋ) and marking ATR vowel harmony and lexical tone inconsistently; no grapheme map is claimed yet. Angsongna & Akinbo (2022), the open-access IPA Illustration for Central Dàgáárè, prints a letter-to-phoneme table on pages 343 and 345; its examples are the dga primary_sources gold rows, and the map is not built from it yet. Glottolog sout2789 'Central Dagaare' carries this code, so that Illustration describes this spec's language. wikidata_qid left unset: the code's Wikidata row resolves to the Wikimedia project item, not the language item; not recorded rather than record a wrong id.

The 35 primary_sources gold rows for dga come from these two tables. The grapheme map is not built from it yet.
